guidance.bestFor: The minimal pattern: 3 questions with one answer open at a time and the first open on load
agentNotes: Replace `items` with your questions; keep each `value` unique, since `defaultValue` opens items by it

whenNotToUse.when: Several answers that can stay open at the same time

guidance.bestFor: Feature summaries that can all stay open at once, each row ending in a plus that flips to a minus
agentNotes: Keep the class on `AccordionTrigger` that hides `accordion-trigger-icon`, or the built-in chevron shows beside the plus and minus

whenNotToUse.when: A list where opening one answer should close the one already open

name: c-accordion-3
title: Accordion with borders and rounded corners
label: Bordered Rounded
description: Accordion with borders and rounded corners

guidance.bestFor: Each question boxed on its own with a gap between, holding long answers in muted text, one open at a time

whenNotToUse.when: A plain divided list with no outline around each question

guidance.bestFor: Plan, billing and security questions under a titled Card header that can open together, the first ending in a View plans button
agentNotes: The annual billing link keeps a placeholder `href` and the View plans `Button` has no handler; point both at your pricing

whenNotToUse.when: Questions set straight on the page with no titled card around them

name: c-accordion-5
title: Accordion with disabled items and highlighted state
label: Disabled Items
description: Accordion with disabled items and highlighted state

guidance.bestFor: One outlined box whose open row takes a muted tint, with a locked middle row that cannot be opened
agentNotes: Replace `items` and set `disabled` per entry; `AccordionItem` takes the flag, so the user cannot open or close that row

name: c-accordion-6
title: Advanced accordion with custom icons and badges
label: Icons & Badges
description: Advanced accordion with custom icons and badges

guidance.bestFor: Spaced card rows led by an icon tile, one open at a time, with a New badge and the panel text indented under the label

whenNotToUse.when: Rows joined in one connected stack that each open without closing the rest

name: c-accordion-7
title: Accordion items integrated within Frame and FramePanel
label: In Frame
description: Accordion items integrated within Frame and FramePanel

guidance.bestFor: Settings rows with icon tiles joined in a stacked Frame, where each panel opens without closing the others
agentNotes: Each `FramePanel` wraps its own `Accordion`, so rows open independently and only the first matches `defaultValue`

whenNotToUse.when: Stacked panels that only group content and never expand or collapse
Sections where only one may be open at any moment

name: c-accordion-8
title: Nested accordion example with bordered items
label: Nested
description: Nested accordion example with bordered items

guidance.bestFor: A product details list where one section opens onto its own inner set of sub sections, both levels open on load
agentNotes: An entry in `mainItems` with `isNested` renders the inner `Accordion` from `nestedItems` in place of its `content`

whenNotToUse.when: A flat list of boxed questions with no second level inside

name: c-accordion-9
title: User list accordion with avatars and role indicators
label: User List
description: User list accordion with avatars and role indicators

guidance.bestFor: Team members shown by avatar, name and role badge, each opening to a summary of what they may access
agentNotes: Replace `users`; its `email` field is never rendered and each `avatar` URL loads a remote Unsplash photo
`role` sets the `Badge` variant: `Admin` gets `success-light` and every other role gets `secondary`
Each `FramePanel` holds a separate `Accordion`, so several people can be open at once

whenNotToUse.when: Settings sections marked by an icon tile in place of a person

guidance.bestFor: A chevron ahead of each question that turns to point down when open, with the answer indented under the text
agentNotes: Keep the class hiding `accordion-trigger-icon` on `AccordionTrigger`, or the default chevrons show next to the `ChevronRightIcon`

whenNotToUse.when: Answers that can stay open together, marked by a plus and minus

name: c-accordion-11
title: Accordion component for onboarding or setup steps with icons, badges, and QR codes
label: Setup Steps
description: Accordion component for onboarding or setup steps with icons, badges, and QR codes

guidance.bestFor: A 3 step setup checklist with done, in progress and pending states, the open step holding an email field and QR code
agentNotes: Step states are hardcoded per `AccordionItem`: the check, the yellow dot and the `Spinner` are markup, not data
The `Input` has only a `placeholder` and the Send link `Button` no handler; add a label and your send action
The QR code is a `QrCodeIcon` placeholder, so render a real code for your app link

whenNotToUse.when: A guided flow where steps run in a fixed order with next and back controls
